content.bridge_context: Introduction to Rational Numbers - numbers that can be written as fractions (p/q).

units.title: What are Rational Numbers?
units.explanation: Any number that can be expressed as a fraction where the denominator is not zero.
units.dual_language_instruction: Is 5 a rational number? Why? / क्या 5 एक परिमेय संख्या है? क्यों?

units.title: Positive and Negative Rationals
units.explanation: If both p and q have same signs, it's positive. If different, it's negative.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify the sign of -3/4. / -3/4 का चिह्न पहचानें।
